videos.desc: In a cozy winter cabin kitchen, a man lifts the lid off a big pot and an enormous cloud of steam billows up, completely fogging his glasses so he cannot see; his friends laugh and wave the white cloud away while holding mugs.
videos.said: Whoa, the cloud! I see nothing!

videos.desc: In a spice-filled kitchen a man clicks the gas stove burners alight one by one, blue flames appear, and a couple sets pots, a pan and a kettle on all four burners to cook together.
videos.said: Click, click, hoo. Click, click, click, hoo. All four going.

videos.desc: Close-up of small silver teaspoons dipped into Turkish tea glasses on saucers; a couple stirs their tea with the tiny spoons, lifts them out and tastes a spoonful each while a cat naps on the windowsill.
videos.said: Plop and stir. Tiny but mighty.

videos.desc: Two hands press peeled bananas into a bed of grated carrot in a lined glass baking dish, then tip in flour and sugar. The baked sponge comes out deep orange and a spoon spreads thick cream cheese frosting over the top. Chopped pistachios are scattered on and a long knife slices the cake down and across into even squares.

A sausage that has been cut into strips at one end so that it splays out like an octopus stands in the oil of a hot black frying pan. Beaten egg is poured from a white bowl all around it and spreads across the pan, and a thin stream of oil is drizzled over the top. The egg sets into a round yellow omelette with the sausage in the middle. The finished omelette is slid out of the pan onto a white plate and chopped green spring onion is sprinkled over it.

A man in a khaki shirt climbs into a dark blue helicopter on a sunny airfield. The camera flies low over pine forest and steep green mountains towards a bright turquoise lake. He stands on the grassy shore with his arms spread wide facing the water and the grey rock walls behind it. He then cracks two eggs onto a flat black pan on a small camping stove set on the rocks by the lake, and finally sits at a low wooden table eating the cooked eggs with sliced bread and tomatoes.

Two hands rinse a raw rack of lamb ribs in a fast mountain stream, with green hills and grazing horses behind. The rack is then laid on a flat stone slab set over glowing red coals and slowly browns, steaming, with the sun low over the hills. A man inflates a big white tent on the grass with an orange pump. Inside the tent, on a patterned carpet, two men sit at a low wooden table and eat the roasted ribs, which are served on a bed of lettuce with cherry tomatoes.

An outdoor evening cooking class under strings of fairy lights: a chef in whites tosses food in a wok over a tall gas flame while the class, all in aprons, lean over the counter watching with their hands under their chins; she sets a finished plate of stir-fry down in front of them and the whole class claps and cheers.

An older woman pulls a tray of just-baked golden rolls out of the oven in a country kitchen. A younger woman in a red apron turns to the camera holding a warm loaf of bread in one hand and a berry tart in the other, mouth open in delight. The table fills with steaming rolls, croissants, loaves and pies straight from the oven, and both women throw their arms up beside it.

A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.

A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.

Three kitchens in a row. A bearded man in a vest tosses sliced peppers and carrots out of a wok over a roaring blue flame in a food truck above a turquoise sea. Then a woman in an apron stir-fries at a street stall in a crowded market street, ladling in stock until a wall of orange flame leaps out of the wok and she laughs behind it. Finally a man in a white double-breasted chef's jacket with his name stitched on the chest sets a sprig of microgreens on a plated dish of pork, carrots and purée in a stainless steel restaurant kitchen, then steps back and looks at it.

A wooden cabin kitchen with a fjord and snowy mountains through the window. A young man in a thick Nordic wool jumper holds a handful of frozen dark berries under the running tap, then picks up a whole raw chicken, pale and frozen, and turns it over under the water so it runs off the skin into the steel sink. Finally he heaves a huge whole salmon up out of the sink and holds it across both hands, mouth wide open in amazement. Jars of preserves and two kettles stand on the counter behind him.

In a pine kitchen an elderly woman in a floral apron pulls an open oven door down and slides out a tray of chocolate-chip cookies while two small girls bounce beside her with clenched fists and open mouths. In close-up her hands hold out two of the warm cookies and each girl bites into one. She then sits in an armchair knitting a blue square on needles with a wool ball in her lap and a girl dozing against her arm, and reads aloud from a picture book with her glasses on. The last shot is a garden table under fruit trees where she and the children sit around a cake stand and teapot.

A cook in a white jacket and tall white hat works in a professional restaurant kitchen: steel counters, a row of gas burners, shelves of pots, a knife rack and bottles of oil on the wall behind her. She tosses a pan over a burner and a tall flame rises; she drops green herbs into peppers and prawns frying in the pan; at the pass she arranges the food on a white plate with tweezers, tastes the sauce from a spoon, then looks up and speaks to the camera.

An elderly woman in a flowery apron winds a sheet of pasta dough through a hand-cranked pasta machine in a rustic kitchen, with cut strips drying on a rack below. She then stirs a big red pot of meat and tomato sauce with a long wooden spoon, blows on it and tastes it, drops in a basil leaf, and finally carries the finished dish out to a long wooden table where a whole family claps and cheers.

Close up, a man's hands slice a tomato into thin rounds with a large kitchen knife on a wooden board. He works along the board slicing cucumber, then yellow pepper, then a red onion, until the board is covered with neat rows of pieces. He straightens up behind the board, which now shows the vegetables laid out in a rainbow-coloured row, and speaks to the camera.

In a small tiled bakery a woman in a white shirt, apron and headscarf slides a tray of custard tarts out of a wood-fired oven whose flames are still burning. She sets the tray on the marble counter, straightens the tarts in their tins and sprinkles powder over them. She then carries the tray to the shop front and holds it out to a small girl, who takes a tart and bites into it, while a crowd of people behind the girl claps and shouts its approval.

A grey-haired man in a striped shirt and apron stands at a hob in a small kitchen with a tall stainless steel stockpot in front of him. He tips a board of chopped carrots, potatoes and red peppers into the empty pot, then pours a jug of golden stock in on top of them. Wearing a padded oven glove he lowers the lid onto the pot; steam rises when he takes it off again, and he stirs the finished vegetable stew with a wooden spoon, smiling at the camera.

At night under rows of red paper lanterns, a smiling young cook in a white headband, white t-shirt and black apron tosses a big bunch of noodles with peppers high into the air from a wok over a bright blue gas flame. The noodles fall back into the wok, he stirs them and then lifts a long bunch up high again. Behind him a crowd holding bowls cheers and films him. Next to him a young woman in a mustard top ladles soup into paper cups beside stacked bamboo steamers.

At a rooftop party at sunset with string lights, potted plants and a view over city roofs, a round barbecue grill bursts into flames. A young woman in a paper party hat, a yellow top and white jeans braces her legs and sprays a red fire extinguisher at the grill, covering it in a big white cloud, though small flames still flicker inside. Behind her a man holds a plate of sausages high over his head, and friends sitting nearby laugh and clap.

A small, steamy home kitchen. A young woman with her hair in a bun, a black T-shirt and a long apron tastes from a wooden spoon at a gas stove covered with bubbling pots, stretching her other arm out to stop her hungry family from coming in, then stirs the pots. An older woman and two men crowd the doorway holding plates, and a cat sits on top of the fridge. The oven is open with a tray of roast potatoes, and bowls of peas, chopped vegetables and a colander of potatoes fill the counter.

A restaurant kitchen seen from the doorway, through a pair of wooden swing doors with a cloth hanging over one. A young woman chef in a white jacket, her hair in a bun, places food on plates next to a pan of vegetables over a blue gas flame. Behind her a young man in a black apron chops greens. The viewer's hands push on the swing doors, and the chef turns towards the door and holds up her palm. Copper pans hang from a rail, lamps glow over the pass and white tiles cover the walls.
